name: Ashcroft Industries Heavy Welding Suit
description:
A full-body welding suit made from aluminized fire-resistant fabric that reflects radiant heat and blocks UV exposure from arc welding. The suit includes integrated gauntlets, a reinforced collar for helmet seating, and spark-catch cuffs at the ankles. Every seam is fire-sealed.

Built for heavy-industry welding operations where the work environment regularly exceeds 200°C ambient from adjacent processes. The suit is stiff, heavy, and hot to wear — but the alternative is third-degree burns and UV-damaged corneas.
functionality: Radiant heat reflection, UV arc protection, full-body spark coverage
what_it_says: You stand next to things that are on fire and your suit is the reason you don't join them.
story_hooks: A heavy welding suit is found with burn patterns on the exterior that don't match any industrial welding profile — the heat source was biological, not mechanical.
